response.reason: The kernel reads from STATE and writes to OUT, but run() passes the same tensor (output = state), making this an in-place overlapping copy. A block writing low rows may execute before another block reads those same locations as source rows (source index = destination index + K*D), so old values can be overwritten before being read; there is no guarantee of block execution order on the GPU.
